name: hover-explain
description: Cmd/Ctrl+hover any symbol for a short AI explanation in the hover. Works with NVIDIA, OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq, Gemini, Ollama, LM Studio, any OpenAI-compatible API, or Claude Code.
author: Revan Sarbast

commands.title: Hover Explain: Explain Symbol at Cursor

enumDescriptions: OpenRouter (hundreds of models behind one key)
LM Studio on this machine (no key)
Claude Code CLI with its own login
hoverExplain.provider.description: Where explanations come from. Easiest to change with "Hover Explain: Choose Provider".

hoverExplain.model.description: Model id for the chosen provider. Empty uses the provider's default (NVIDIA: nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b-a3b, Claude Code: haiku); other providers need one. "Hover Explain: Choose Model" lists what's available.

hoverExplain.baseUrl.description: Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible API (the part before /chat/completions). Required for the custom provider; overrides the built-in URL for the others.

hoverExplain.claudePath.description: Path to the claude CLI. Empty = ~/.local/bin/claude, then PATH.

hoverExplain.timeoutSeconds.description: Give up on a request after this many seconds.
